website.rationale: Homepage claims remain accurate; published hero, Dock and feature originals/exports/provenance were refreshed through the repository recipe, and generated Docs include the new guide chapters. Reviewed privacy impact over baseline 66b9eff962567b769d8f77b012724895c048c2af to candidate 0a8f7857a67f0aa1d2803573e03d22a242c2c839: Quick Tour disposition is identity-local, synchronized across local workbenches and excluded from configuration export; there is no tour telemetry. Update Control invokes the existing explicit Check for Updates and does not install or download. New target geometry and pointer actions are local. Dock recording now can include desktop/other-app pixels behind transparent surfaces, which is documented; captures are explicitly requested local artifacts, with no automatic upload or new recipient. No changed collection/consent/upload payload/provider/service configuration/remote retention or deletion behavior was found. Feedback, crash reporting, newsletter and update-service code/configuration are unchanged. The policy text and October 16, 2026 effective date are retained; no new live-service configuration uncertainty was introduced.
